set.body:
Purpose

Complete raw fMRI to local crossnobis with an estimated metric and turn the residual-reuse question into empirical evidence.

Policies

Compare at least training-only residual statistics with all-declared-run residual statistics under an explicit GLM residual-orthogonality contract. Do not label either field-standard without primary-source support; record per-run/fold alternatives where relevant.

Acceptance

- Both policies execute through the same plan with different metric-recipe identities.
- Deliberate undeclared evaluation-data access fails before numerical evaluation.
- Paired simulations report null centering, conditional-target bias, population-Mahalanobis bias, variance, RMSE, and Monte Carlo uncertainty.
- Shrinkage-target estimation is included in the provenance and uncertainty analysis.
- Results distinguish evaluator correctness from learner quality.
- No confidence interval or LD-t view is exported until calibration accounts for randomness in the learned metric.
- A material policy difference becomes a durable evidence report and follow-up research issue, not a hidden default.
set.title: Epic 7: Compare learned-metric provenance policies in the vertical slice
